pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Listbox (multi-select, recommended selection model): each list is role=listbox with aria-multiselectable; focus stays on the listbox and aria-activedescendant names the active option; aria-selected marks checked options.

aria.value: the list title / its item count
the active option while it is rendered
position in the filtered list (rows are windowed)
true for disabled items / a disabled control
required and the shown validation state
Move checked items to Selected, Search Available, and so on

keyboard.key: Home / End / Page Up / Page Down
keyboard.action: First, last, or a page of options.
Check or uncheck the active option.
Check the range from the anchor to the active option.
Check all visible options (again: uncheck all).
Move the checked options (or the active one) to the other list.
Search, list, buttons, search, list, in reading order.

focus: Focus stays on the listbox; the active option is shown with an outline. After a button moves the last items and disables itself, focus returns to the source list.
notes: Moves are announced ("2 items moved to Selected"); counts are polite status messages.
Dragging is optional and always has a single-pointer and keyboard alternative: check items and press a move button (WCAG 2.5.7).
Windowed rows carry aria-setsize and aria-posinset so screen readers announce the position in the full list.
knownCaveats: When the active option is scrolled out of the rendered window with the mouse, the listbox has no active descendant until the next key press.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
